messages:
anya: EmberSilica bench intake — need to lock down the perf/W + kernel tuning plan for their P0 SKU. @vikram @jordan can you confirm the sweep matrix and telemetry fields?
vikram: On it. Proposal: run Llama-2-13B (13B) at seq 2048 and 4096, power caps 100W/150W/200W, and compare quant variants q4_0 / q8_0. We should capture tail-latency and power samples at 10Hz. Need Ember to share driver knobs and any required firmware flags.
jordan: Lab slot Wed 9-12 PT is available. Partner asked for a short runbook + acceptance criteria. Telemetry ingestion is at https://telemetry.redwood.dev/ingest (X-API-KEY auth). We'll collect power_w, gpu_util, p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput.
sam: I reserved the rack and cleared the bench. Ember contact (Tom) dropped PCIe firmware v1.2 in their drive — will forward. Tom wants a one-pager with acceptance criteria (perf/W improvement thresholds and stable tail latency).
vikram: quick kernel snippets below — baseline flags and run command:
```
# kernel boot flags for bench (example)
intel_pstate=disable nohz_full=1 rcu_nocbs=0-3 isolcpus=4-7 mce=off
# cgroups: cpuset.cpus=4-7
# run script
./run_throughput.sh --model llama-13b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant q4_0 --powercap 150
```
anya: Perfect. Jordan, can you add that to the runbook and wire the telemetry keys? Sam — can you confirm dataset size? I'd suggest 500 synthetic prompts to get stable stats.
jordan: Drafted runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ember-silica-bench (draft). Telemetry schema keys: ["timestamp","device_id","power_w","gpu_util","p99_latency_ms","throughput_tps","kv_cache_hit_rate"]. Will hook up Grafana panels and alert thresholds.
sam: 500 prompts staged at /data/bench/ember_silica/500.json.gz. I'll set up artifact uploads to s3://redwood-bench/ember/1715500000/ and do a smoke run Tue evening.
bench-bot: Runbook template created and attached. JIRA created: INF-7890 assigned to @vikram. Reminder: tag experiments with "ember-silica-2026-03".
anya: Action items: Vikram — kernel patches + full run matrix; Jordan — finalize runbook + telemetry ingestion; Sam — lab prep, dataset, artifact path; I will draft the partner-facing one-pager and schedule a Thurs 10am PT sync with Ember. If no blockers, proceed.
vikram: Ack — will push kernel patch notes to bench/ember-silica branch and include expected perf deltas.
jordan: Ack — will build Grafana dashboard and add dashboard link to runbook.
sam: Ack — will validate rack power meters and do a smoke.
anya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll loop Tom in via email after this thread and attach the one-pager.
